name: Ty Dolla $ign
biography: Tyrone William Griffin Jr., better known by his stage name Ty Dolla $ign, is an American singer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, record producer and actor. He first gained major recognition in 2010 for his feature on American rapper YG's single "Toot It and Boot It".
